learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will learn what pronouns are, how they replace nouns, and identify Personal, Possessive, Demonstrative, and Reflexive pronouns.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Imagine saying: 'Rohan ate Rohan's lunch because Rohan was hungry.' Sounds tiring, right? That's where Pronouns come to the rescue! Let's meet these handy substitute words. 🦸‍♂️

lesson_modules.teaching_content: A Pronoun is a word used in place of a noun to avoid repeating the same noun over and over again.
examples_or_templates: Instead of 'Sita is happy because Sita won', we say 'Sita is happy because SHE won.'

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Personal pronouns stand for people or things (I, you, he, she, it, we, they). Possessive pronouns show ownership or belonging (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs).
examples_or_templates: Personal: THEY went to the park.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Demonstrative pronouns point to specific things (this, that, these, those). Reflexive pronouns are used when the action reflects back to the subject (myself, yourself, themselves).
examples_or_templates: Demonstrative: THAT is a beautiful car.
Reflexive: I baked this cake MYSELF.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which pronoun correctly completes the sentence? 'My parents are traveling. _____ will be back tomorrow.'
❓ Identify the type of pronoun used in uppercase: 'The red jacket is HERS.'

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Replace the repeated nouns with suitable pronouns: 'Tom loves playing football. Tom plays football every evening.'
subjective_practice.hint: Use a personal pronoun for the boy, and a personal pronoun for the sport.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank with a Reflexive pronoun: 'The cat cleaned _________ after eating.'
subjective_practice.hint: Think about the pronoun used for animals ('it') and add '-self'.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Choose the correct Demonstrative pronoun: '(This / Those) apples are very sweet.'
subjective_practice.hint: Apples are plural, so choose the plural pointing word.

activity_or_assignment.title: ✂️ The Pronoun Swap
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Write a short paragraph (4-5 lines) about your best friend using only their name. Then, rewrite the exact same paragraph replacing their name with the correct pronouns!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Pronouns replace nouns to make sentences less repetitive.
⭐ Personal pronouns replace names, while Possessive pronouns show ownership.
⭐ Demonstrative pronouns point things out, and Reflexive pronouns bounce the action back to the subject.
